% ========================================================
% Template configuration (DO NOT EDIT)
% ========================================================
% This file keeps the original template's identity/contact placeholders.
% When \TemplateModetrue, config/resume-config.tex will load this file.

% ----- Identity -----
% Tip: set fields to empty (e.g., {}) to hide them.
\newcommand{\ResumeName}{Your Name}
\newcommand{\ResumeTagline}{Your Title / Focus (e.g., Software Engineer | ML)}

% Optional summary (2--3 lines). Leave empty ({}) to hide the section.
\newcommand{\ResumeSummary}{% e.g., Backend engineer focused on AI/ML systems. Built X. Interested in Y.
}

% ----- Contact -----
\newcommand{\ResumePhone}{+1 (XXX) XXX-XXXX}
\newcommand{\ResumePhoneLink}{tel:+1-000-000-0000}
\newcommand{\ResumeEmail}{you@example.com}
\newcommand{\ResumeEmailLink}{mailto:you@example.com}

% Optional location for the header (leave empty to hide)
% \ResumeLocation is the link target (optional); \ResumeLocationText is what prints.
\newcommand{\ResumeLocation}{} % e.g., https://maps.google.com/?q=San+Francisco,+CA
\newcommand{\ResumeLocationText}{} % e.g., San Francisco, CA

% Display text vs URL can differ (nice for ATS and readability)
\newcommand{\ResumeLinkedInText}{linkedin.com/in/yourhandle}
\newcommand{\ResumeLinkedInURL}{https://linkedin.com/in/yourhandle}
\newcommand{\ResumeGithubText}{github.com/yourhandle}
\newcommand{\ResumeGithubURL}{https://github.com/yourhandle}
\newcommand{\ResumeWebsiteText}{yourwebsite.com}
\newcommand{\ResumeWebsiteURL}{https://yourwebsite.com}

% ----- Optional toggles -----
% If true: prefer text-only header + project links (more ATS-friendly).
% If false: use icons where applicable.
\newif\ifATS
\ATStrue

% If true: show the website field (when non-empty). If false: always hide it.
\newif\ifShowWebsite
\ShowWebsitetrue

% Optional: enable microtype (typographic polish). If you use strict ATS parsing,
% validate the output with your target ATS before turning this on.
\newif\ifUseMicrotype
\UseMicrotypefalse

% ----- Section toggles (so you don't have to uncomment lines in main.tex) -----
\newif\ifIncludeCertifications
\newif\ifIncludeAwards
\newif\ifIncludeLeadership
\newif\ifIncludePublications

% Defaults (turn on what you want)
\IncludeCertificationsfalse
\IncludeAwardsfalse
\IncludeLeadershipfalse
\IncludePublicationsfalse

% ----- PDF metadata -----
\newcommand{\PDFTitle}{Resume - Your Name}
\newcommand{\PDFAuthor}{Your Name}
\newcommand{\PDFSubject}{Resume}
\newcommand{\PDFKeywords}{software engineer, machine learning, artificial intelligence, resume}
